## upload

independent upload-path branches

### gaps (7)

- `timeoutStruct`: absent · present
- `selfRemoval`: false · true
- `uploadRevert`: RaceConditionDisputeEvidencePeriodExpired · ErrorDisputeAlreadyPosted · ErrorDisputePostedAuditingDataMismatch

### covered (5)

- `uploadRevert=clean` <- second postDispute from same disputer after evidenceTime → dispute upload succeeds (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputerThrottle.test.ts:50) · dispute.input.latestInboundMessageBlockHash = ZeroHash AND lastInboundMessageBlockHeight = 0 → dispute upload succeeds (genesis anchor is always a valid ancestor) (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/latestInboundMessageBlockHash.test.ts:6)
- `uploadRevert=ErrorCantParticipateInDispute` <- dispute.input.channelId = random → dispute upload fails → ErrorCantParticipateInDispute (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/channelId.test.ts:18) · spectator (not an eligible participant) attempts to dispute → ErrorCantParticipateInDispute (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputer.test.ts:40)
- `uploadRevert=ErrorDisputerNotMsgSender` <- dispute.input.disputer = ZeroAddress → dispute upload fails → ErrorDisputerNotMsgSender (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputer.test.ts:20)
- `uploadRevert=ErrorDisputeThrottled` <- second postDispute from same disputer within evidenceTime → dispute upload fails → ErrorDisputeThrottled (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputerThrottle.test.ts:12) · postDispute reuses dispute.input.forkId from another peer's open window within evidenceTime → dispute upload fails → ErrorDisputeThrottled (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputerThrottle.test.ts:79)
- `uploadRevert=ErrorAuditingDataHashMismatch` <- with calldata: dispute.input.disputeAuditingDataHash tampered → dispute upload fails → ErrorAuditingDataHashMismatch (test/unit/dispute-upload/uploadRevert/disputeAuditingDataHash.test.ts:20)

## stateProofAssembly

getStateProof / tryBuildMilestone assembly semantics

### gaps (5)

- `participantChangePoints`: zero · one
- `signatureCollection`: direct-one-block
- `thresholdUnion`: with-joiner · unchanged

### covered (3)

- `participantChangePoints=two-plus` <- two leavers across milestones → milestones-only proof with one finality milestone per change point (test/unit/dispute-upload/stateProofAssembly.test.ts:14)
- `signatureCollection=virtual-voting` <- partially-signed tip → milestone threshold completed from an earlier block's signers (virtual voting) (test/unit/dispute-upload/stateProofAssembly.test.ts:32)
- `thresholdUnion=with-leaver` <- milestone at a leave change point still counts the leaver's signature toward its threshold (test/unit/dispute-upload/stateProofAssembly.test.ts:81)
